# HypeRate triggers

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to HypeRate. Handy for a quick "all good" message or to switch something on.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |
| `%sessionId%` | The HypeRate ID you are watching |

<small>Type id: `hyperate.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to HypeRate. Handy to warn yourself that alerts have stopped.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |

<small>Type id: `hyperate.disconnected`</small>

## Every heart rate reading

Runs for every new heart rate reading from HypeRate. It can run about once a second, so keep the action short.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%heartRate%` | Heart rate right now, in beats per minute |
| `%previousHeartRate%` | The heart rate before this one |
| `%source%` | Where it came from: Pulsoid or HypeRate |

<small>Type id: `hyperate.heartRate`</small>

## Heart rate above threshold

Runs once when your HypeRate heart rate reaches a number you pick or goes higher. Fun for a "calm down!" moment.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Threshold (BPM)** | The heart rate to watch for, in beats per minute. It runs when you reach this number or higher. Starts as: `120`. |
| **Reset distance (BPM)** | How far your heart rate must fall below the threshold before this can run again. Stops it firing over and over when you hover near the number. Starts as: `5`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%heartRate%` | Heart rate right now, in beats per minute |
| `%previousHeartRate%` | The heart rate before this one |
| `%source%` | Where it came from: Pulsoid or HypeRate |
| `%heartRateThreshold%` | The threshold you set |

<small>Type id: `hyperate.heartRateAbove`</small>

## Heart rate below threshold

Runs once when your HypeRate heart rate drops to a number you pick or lower. Fun for a "are you still alive?" moment.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Threshold (BPM)** | The heart rate to watch for, in beats per minute. It runs when you reach this number or lower. Starts as: `60`. |
| **Reset distance (BPM)** | How far your heart rate must rise above the threshold before this can run again. Stops it firing over and over when you hover near the number. Starts as: `5`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%heartRate%` | Heart rate right now, in beats per minute |
| `%previousHeartRate%` | The heart rate before this one |
| `%source%` | Where it came from: Pulsoid or HypeRate |
| `%heartRateThreshold%` | The threshold you set |

<small>Type id: `hyperate.heartRateBelow`</small>

## Heart rate changed

Runs when your HypeRate heart rate changes enough. Good for updating a number on screen without running every second.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum seconds between runs** | The least number of seconds to wait between runs. 5 means at most one run every five seconds. Starts as: `5`. |
| **Minimum change (BPM)** | Only run when your heart rate moved at least this many beats per minute since the last run. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%heartRate%` | Heart rate right now, in beats per minute |
| `%previousHeartRate%` | The heart rate before this one |
| `%source%` | Where it came from: Pulsoid or HypeRate |
| `%lastTriggeredHeartRate%` | The heart rate at the last run |
| `%heartRateChange%` | How much it changed since then (minus means it fell) |

<small>Type id: `hyperate.heartRateChanged`</small>

## Twitch clip created

Runs when a Twitch clip is made through HypeRate. Handy to share the clip link in chat.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%clipUrl%` | The web link to the clip |
| `%twitchSlug%` | The clip's short name |

<small>Type id: `hyperate.clipCreated`</small>
